description: List the domains available to this key -- the domains this account has onboarded in benchmarq (or, for a key limited to specific domains, just those). trigger_page_scan and every other domain-based tool only accept these domains -- check this first rather than guessing and hitting DOMAIN_NOT_TRACKED. Same data as the benchmarq://domains resource, offered as a tool too since not every MCP client surfaces resources to the model.
name: get_tracked_domains
title: Get tracked domains
